messages:
rachel: Quick heads-up — eng-platform is planning to accept a new header `X-RW-ROUTE-POLICY` (JSON blob) to drive routing decisions (priority + quota_tag). It may affect SDK surface. Plan is to start a phased rollout this week. Thoughts?

 t omas: Oof, that could be breaking if clients parse/normalize headers. Is it required or opt-in? Any concrete example payload?

 rachel: Optional for now. If present it will be authoritative and can change quota bucketing. Example payload: ```json
{"priority":"low","quota_tag":"team:search"}
```
We will accept both header and new metadata field in gRPC proto.

 aditya: SDK owners — recommend tolerant parsing and a fallback path. Don't error on unknown keys; log a warning and continue. Also propose supporting the old `X-RW-ROUTE` header for 2 releases.

 sofia: From Console/product side: we want `quota_tag` surfaced as a cost-center in dashboards and in CSV exports. Need consistent key names across SDKs so telemetry ingestion maps cleanly.

 cameron: Can the edge proxy add a translation shim (old header -> new JSON header) to buy time for SDK changes? That would reduce immediate churn.

 tomas: Shim helps but SDKs still need a new option in client APIs to construct structured route policy. For TS/Python propose adding `routePolicy: {priority, quotaTag}` to request options; fallback to writing headers if present.

 aditya: Timeline proposal: shim live Fri, TS/Go PRs by next Wed, Python by next Fri. Add a deprecation-warning response header for 30 days so we can track clients still sending old header.

 rachel: We'll also start emitting `route_policy.version=2` in runtime logs once shim is enabled. SDKs should include `route_policy.version` in telemetry so dashboards align.

 kai: Small UX ask from DevEx: add a console toggle "Show routed cost centers" (off by default). When customers opt-in we should include per-request `quota_tag` in CSVs. Also need a docs snippet for SDK examples.

 sofia: I'll add the console toggle and wire an event name `console:route_policy_optin`. Backend will respect customer opt-in and only include extra columns when enabled.

 tomas: Two metric concerns: don't explode cardinality with arbitrary `quota_tag` values. We should validate tags against a regex/whitelist and map unknowns to `quota_tag=custom` for metrics, while keeping raw in audit logs.

 rachel: Agreed — ingestion pipeline will whitelist high-frequency tags for metrics and store raw tags in long-term audit logs.

 aditya: For SDK changes we can add helpers that validate/mask `quota_tag` before sending telemetry. Example usage: ```js
client.request({input, routePolicy:{priority:'low', quotaTag:'team:search'}})
```
Fallback header example: ```http
X-RW-ROUTE-POLICY: {"priority":"low","quota_tag":"team:search"}
X-RW-ROUTE: team:search
```

 tomas: Can somebody add an integration test asserting that old header still results in expected routing behavior? I want a regression test.

 cameron: I'll add a canary + feature-flagged rollout.

 deploy-bot: shim-proxy deployed to canary-01 at 2026-03-20T10:12Z :rocket:

 rachel: Action items: cameron to deploy shim to 3 canaries, aditya to open TS/Go PRs (link here when ready), tomas to add integration tests, sofia to add console toggle + docs stub, kai to collect example snippets. Reconvene Thurs 11am. :thumbsup:
